todo: Purpose: Build Lumen’s pad rim, habitat tier and crater floor as readable connected heights.
Visual brief: A broad rounded rim built from cell-plan terraces, a dark wall under the lip and seated dust at the foot; ejecta lies over the top, while the side walls remain physically continuous.
Widths and size: Face height equals the authored T2/T1/T0 delta; use 32+ world-px cliff class (96+ art px), not one fixed rim image scaled to fit.
Implement after review: choose authored anchors, exact collision and approved variant art; these cell envelopes are layout proposals, not measured sprite bounds.
The tube/stair is the route between tiers. A shadow mask is visual and cannot stand in for a wall or ice collision.
Sizing basis: material/edge extent is specified in 24-art-px logical cells; no opaque-object scale class is assigned. Review grain, width class and derived face height instead.
Lighting: Upper left; material-specific ramps and directional planes; no mirror-only relighting.
